title: Demis Hassabis and Dario Amodei, in their own words
source: Exact words, each linked to where it was said and checked against it.

hassabis.quote: I think I’m still on the same kind of timeline.
hassabis.venue: World Economic Forum, The Day After AGI

amodei.quote: if I had to guess, I would guess that this goes faster than people imagine
amodei.venue: World Economic Forum, The Day After AGI

hassabis.quote: Urgent action is needed to address risks that might arise as we get closer to AGI.
hassabis.venue: Essay, A Framework for Frontier AI and the Dawning of a New Age

amodei.quote: However, now the risks are clearly here. It is time to go beyond transparency to more serious and binding regulation of AI.
amodei.venue: Essay, Policy on the AI Exponential

hassabis.quote: Dario’s essay points towards the right path forward. The details need working through, but the direction is correct for meeting this critical moment.

amodei.quote: We must slow the pace at which we improve the capabilities of AI models.
amodei.venue: Essay, We Must Pace the Frontier

hassabis.quote: AGI has the potential to be the ultimate tool for advancing science and medicine, and to drive enormous productivity gains and economic growth.
hassabis.venue: Essay, A Framework for Frontier AI and the Dawning of a New Age

amodei.quote: AI-enabled biology and medicine will allow us to compress the progress that human biologists would have achieved over the next 50-100 years into 5-10 years.
